idea.title: Weekly Surge In Freight Logistics Google Trends For Port Congestion
idea.thesis: Rising port congestion searches indicate supply chain delays and logistics cost increases. Industrial sector faces margin pressure and delivery delays from port bottlenecks.
data_sources: Google Trends weekly search interest for 'port congestion'
idea.signal_logic: If weekly search interest rises 20% above 4-week average
idea.entry_exit: Entry: If weekly search interest rises 20% above 4-week average Exit: When search interest returns to baseline or declines for 2 weeks
idea.position_sizing: Allocate 5% per signal, max 20% total exposure.
idea.risks: Data source instability, false positives, and regime shifts.
idea.implementation_notes: Use Google Trends weekly search interest for 'port congestion' via api (weekly).
idea.reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Port congestion fluctuates seasonally and with global trade news, causing repeatable search spikes.
